allocations.purpose: Stranded edge-virus endgame benchmark: one pill-stream seed per bank group (position, its left-right mirror and grounded control twins), shared by every candidate and pace
Continuous rating pool bank: every pool pairing plays these games, side-swapped, in reserve order; reused across pairings, conditions and levels, never by training

Big-clear setup benchmark: one fresh pill-stream seed per bank group (held-out human T2+ setup at lookbacks 6 and 10 plus its matched no-big-clear control), shared by every candidate and pace; the replay condition uses each row's own source-game seed
Big-clear natural style panel: level-14 natural games from the start, candidate vs the parent, side-swapped seed pairs, full move traces for big-clear rate and size
